description: Read account sending readiness, domain verification, daily usage, and recent reputation state. While the sending domain is not yet verified it also returns `records`: the DNS records to publish. `sentToday` counts the last 24 hours on a rolling basis, while `sharedTrial.sendsUsed` counts the account's lifetime sends on the shared trial, so the two legitimately differ. Does not send mail.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: read_sending_status
title: Read sending status
